description: Installs Pegasus + planning-only Condor, rebuilds PMC against the system MPI, plans PMC-only DAGs and runs them under Flux with dftracer, using software_pegasus_recipe and software_pegasus_check.
instructions: Query software_pegasus_recipe (install_*, pmc_rebuild, properties, sites_yml, plan, verify_plan, run_pmc) before acting; run software_pegasus_check over every planned command list. Verify the DAG (TASK/EDGE only) and replica paths before launching PMC.
